The number of Europeans will decline by approximately 6% by 2050.
India has almost 1.46 billion people in 2022. China's population reached 1.45 billion in 2022. China is expected to have approximately 1.42 billion people in 2025.
The world's population is expected to reach around 10.3 billion people in the 2080s. The global population is estimated to pass 10 billion by 2060.
The United States will have 421 million inhabitants in 2100. Nigeria's population is expected to reach 400 million by 2060.

Africa's population is forecast to grow to 3.9 billion by 2100. Egypt's population is expected to increase by 120% by 2100. Bosnia-Herzegovina is expected to have a 50% decrease in population by 2100.
India is expected to reach 1.7 billion by 2050. Pakistan has around 243 million inhabitants in 2025.
The Population Weighted Density for the USA is 2.2k pp/km2 for 2020.
China's population has decreased by 0.23%. India's annual growth rate is 0.89%.
91.4% of Brazil's population live in urban areas.
By 2100, there will be almost four people age 65 and older for every person age 14 and younger.
